findings.name: relation preference cancels from modality conditional pooling
findings.observed: aS changes frequency aggregation f but not pooled modality m when U/V/psi are held fixed
findings.limits: Source algebra only. Does not prove a cause of poor efficacy; shared features and frequency route remain jointly trained.

findings.name: auxiliary identity taps precede retrieval projections
findings.observed: Standalone m0/f0 pooled vectors feed auxiliary CE/Triplet; PM/PF projections feed fused descriptor. Stopped contribution targets do not directly train PM/PF.
findings.limits: Projection parameters still receive fused ReID gradients; no claim they are untrained.

test.kind: Fixed arbitrary scalar U/V/c/psi, change only aS; pure Python float64 algebra, no Torch or GPU
